blocks.text: When you create a move-in, the system proposes an existing meter reading result for all the billing-relevant registers allocated to the devices for billing purposes. Ensure you have configured the system accordingly in Customizing under SAP Utilities > Device Management > Meter Reading > Basic Settings > Define Control Parameters for Meter Reading Data Processing .
- If the system proposes a meter reading result then choose one of the following two options:

- If you adopt the meter reading result, the system adds the meter reading reason Move-in to the result.
- If you change the meter reading result, a new result is created with the meter reading reason Move-in .

- If the system does not propose a meter reading result, you can have it estimate a result or enter one manually. In both cases, the system creates a new meter reading result from the adopted/changed result and gives it the meter reading reason Move-In .

- If the system does not propose a meter reading result, and you do not enter one manually, a service notification or service order is created for the current register. For more information see service notifications and orders .

You can also suppress the meter reading proposal or define an interval as required. If you do this, the system only makes a proposal if the meter reading result on which the proposal is based was takes during the interval. Ensure you have configured the system accordingly in Customizing under SAP Utilities > Device Management > Meter Reading > Basic Settings > Define Control Parameters for Meter Reading Data Processing . Ensure that you make an appropriate entry in the Move-in prop. inter. (Interval for determining default value) and the Display default move-in value checkbox alongside it.
You can find additional information on meter reading data processing in the section on the meter reading component.
